items.title: 61427_Happy Caldwell oral history interview
items.q: I know like at Zooty's funeral -- I forgot the trombone player's name, Milt Hampton, and they played a couple numbers.

ctx.x: But I don't think you need about six or seven different acts.
No, no, definitely not. I know like at Zooty's funeral -- I forgot the trombone player's name, Milt Hampton, and they played a couple numbers. That was enough.
